# Third-party components bundled in MDView

| Component | License | Source |
|---|---|---|
| CodeMirror 6 (@codemirror/*, @lezer/*) | MIT | https://codemirror.net — prebuilt ES bundle taken from NiceGUI (MIT) `nicegui/elements/codemirror/dist`, see cm/source-package.json |
| @uiw/codemirror-themes-all | MIT | https://github.com/uiwjs/react-codemirror (included in the CodeMirror bundle) |
| Prism.js | MIT | https://prismjs.com (see PRISM-LICENSE.txt) |
| KaTeX / Mermaid / WaveDrom | MIT | loaded at runtime from lib/ or CDN; not embedded |
